description: This file defines assertion helper functions, macros, and related utilities for error reporting and debugging within the ocudu project. It includes functions for formatted assertion failure messages and macros for various levels of assertions and error handling.

methods.name: print_and_abort_1
methods.description: Formats and prints assertion failure message with file, line, function, and condition info, then aborts.

methods.name: print_and_abort_2
methods.description: Formats and prints additional assertion message, then aborts the program.
